An organic infinity pool with its own white terrazzo beach.
The lagoon, steps from the bedrooms.
Loungers on the sand, palms all around.
The art lounge, behind panoramic glass.

story_lead: On the calmer side of Canggu, River Point is built around its own blue lagoon: an organic infinity pool with a white terrazzo beach, steps from the bedrooms. Award-winning tropical modernist architecture, a double-height living room behind panoramic glass, and interiors inspired by 1970s California, finished with works by a Balinese contemporary artist.
story_points: 5 bedrooms for up to 10 guests, with a master suite upstairs
Blue-lagoon infinity pool with a white terrazzo beach
Art lounge, upper lounge, sunset terrace and open-air barbecue area
Fresh-air climate system, backup generator, private parking
book_lead: Book direct, with no platform fees. Before you arrive, a private concierge prepares your stay: private chef, transfers and experiences on request.
